messages.speaker: Narrator
messages.text:
Rain taps against the metal awning outside Kestrel Pawn.

Juno Marr slides a cracked identity chip across the counter and keeps her voice low.

(Juno Marr) "This came in under your name. That means someone is either wearing your life or trying to bury it. Start by telling me where you were last night."
